# The Mindmaker

> 1:1 sprints and enterprise advisory helping leaders make nervous AI decisions. Founded by Krish Raja.

## Core offers

- [1:1 Sprints](/sprints): Builder or Orchestrator tracks. 4-week ($18,000) or 90-day ($60,000).
- [Enterprise](/enterprise): The Signal Session ($15,000). The Revenue Architecture ($60,000–$80,000).

## Try it

- [The Nervous Decision Machine](/tool): One-shot decision-reframing tool. Free, no email required.
- [The Signal Desk](/signal): Weekly classification of AI signal, noise, decisions and takes.
- [Decision Readiness Diagnostic](/leaders): Builder vs Orchestrator self-diagnostic.

## Positioning

Mindmaker sells sprints and blueprints, not calendar hours. Every engagement has a fixed scope and a finish line. No fractional executive roles. No ongoing retainers. No production IT work. The primary conversion goal is booking a qualified call with Krish.
